title: Jessica Utts statistical analysis of CIA Stargate psychic spying

tellings.quote: Jessica Us uh the statistician studying all the sort of you know psychic spy Stargate stuff coming out coming out of the CIA it does seem like a lot of these things fall way below you know p values that you'd expect

plain: The results of Stargate, a long-running US effort backed by the CIA to use psychics as spies, were judged by the statistician Jessica Utts to be far less likely to come from chance than you would expect. Michels brings this up himself, saying the numbers "fall way below" the odds you would expect by luck. If true, it would mean psychic spying showed real effects.
